title: Alumni Association
body:
Join the Alumni Legacy

The Alumni Association of Amer Maharaja P.G. College serves as a lifelong bridge between the institution and its graduates. We believe that our students remain a vital part of our community long after they have completed their studies. Our mission is to foster a strong network that encourages professional collaboration, mentorship, and continuous engagement with the college's growth.

Objectives and Benefits

The primary goal of the association is to reconnect, reminisce, and stay updated with fellow graduates. Members benefit from networking opportunities, invitations to college events, and the chance to mentor current students by sharing industry insights. By maintaining this connection, alumni play a crucial role in enhancing the college's reputation and supporting its academic and infrastructural development.

Stay Connected

We encourage all former students of the Faculty of Arts, Science, and Commerce to register with the Alumni Cell. Through our dedicated portal, you can stay informed about the latest announcements, alumni meets, and success stories of your peers. Join us in celebrating the shared legacy and future successes of Amer Maharaja P.G. College.
